signal_actions.name: Start
signal_actions.description: Start the 1.0.95 adaptive pattern-engine release using compiled defaults or cap_init/trading_amount/min_tp_percent/min_sl_percent/risk_target_percent/entry_type/required_samples overrides. All MRC patterns are classified independently; the selector trades the best learned candidate and continues line-to-line while it remains best. Market entries open immediately. Limit entries use the selected pattern price or two ticks beyond market when already crossed; any unfilled limit entry is cancelled after the next candle, and a new signal is evaluated only after cancellation is confirmed.

params.name: Initial budget %
params.description: Percent of max_amount reserved for the internal trading budget.

params.name: Trading amount %
params.description: Normal entry size as a percent of the deployable budget. Clamped to 10-100.

params.name: Minimum TP %
params.description: Minimum TP distance for every MRC pattern exit. 0 disables this floor.

params.name: Minimum SL %
params.description: Minimum SL distance for every strategy exit. A closer stop is expanded away from entry; 0 disables this minimum.

params.name: Risk target %
params.description: Optional target price-movement risk. When greater than 0, reduce the aggregate entry size when the projected stop-loss distance is wider than this percentage; 0 disables the adjustment.

params.name: Required samples
params.description: Minimum number of observations used by the adaptive pattern engine before normal learned statistics are considered; continuation patterns can still trade when a stair is detected.

params.name: Entry order
params.description: Market opens immediately. Limit uses the strategy solution or two ticks beyond market when already crossed, then expires after the next candle if it is not filled. Configured minimum TP and SL distances apply to the exit; a new signal is evaluated after the cancellation is confirmed.
